name: Garments of the Moon
summary: Laurna Morninglight sends a young priest to aid a wounded Sentinel south of Dolanaar. The duty tests an initiate's devotion and brings formal recognition in the Sisterhood of Elune.

sections.title: A Sacred Calling
sections.body: The Sisterhood of Elune guides kaldorei in worship and helps defend Teldrassil's borders. Sentinel Shaya is wounded while patrolling the wilderness south of Dolanaar, and priest trainer Laurna Morninglight cannot leave her post to help. She asks a newly trained initiate to tend Shaya's wounds and strengthen her with protective magic.

sections.title: Vestments of the Sisterhood
sections.body: After restoring Sentinel Shaya's vigor, a priest returns to Dolanaar to receive formal robes of office from Laurna Morninglight. The robes mark an acolyte's passage from classroom instruction to practical service that can save lives. For the kaldorei, aiding the Sentinels is both service to Elune and a duty to Teldrassil's safety.

faq.q: Who offers the quest Garments of the Moon?
aliases: who gives garments of the moon
where to start garments of the moon
faq.answer: Laurna Morninglight, the priest trainer in Dolanaar's northern building, offers Garments of the Moon.

faq.q: Who needs help during this task?
faq.answer: Sentinel Shaya needs help. Wounded while patrolling the wilderness, she waits just south of Dolanaar.

faq.q: What magic is required to help Sentinel Shaya?
aliases: what spells to cast on shaya
how to complete garments of the moon
faq.answer: You use healing magic to tend Sentinel Shaya's wounds and protective wards to strengthen her before returning to Dolanaar.

faq.q: Can any class take this quest?
aliases: is garments of the moon priest only
garments of the moon class requirement
can druids do garments of the moon
faq.answer: No. Only night elf priests can receive Garments of the Moon, an early milestone in their spiritual training.

faq.q: What does the robe reward symbolize?
aliases: garments of the moon robe meaning
significance of garments of the moon
faq.answer: The robe awarded by Laurna Morninglight marks your service to Elune and your recognized place among the local priesthood.

faq.q: What is the relationship between this quest and In Favor of Elune?
faq.answer: In Favor of Elune is an introductory summons to visit the trainer in Dolanaar. It is not required for Garments of the Moon, but cannot be completed after Garments of the Moon is finished.

angles.text: As a priest, you restore wounded allies through prayer and shield them from danger with divine wards.
As a kaldorei, you belong to a people whose Sisterhood of Elune and Sentinels have worked together for millennia to protect the forests and their people from encroaching darkness.
